title: Configurable Spawners
description: Configurable your spawners — faster spawning, more mobs, custom particles, glow effects, and full in-game config via Mod Menu!
body:
# Configurable Spawners

Take full control of every mob spawner in your world. Whether you want 
a hardcore grinder or a slow trickle, everything is adjustable — 
directly in-game through a clean Mod Menu config screen.

## Features

- Faster or slower spawn delays
- More mobs spawned per attempt
- Higher nearby entity cap so spawners don't idle early
- Custom spawn radius around the spawner
- Glow effect on spawned mobs so you can track them easily
- Configurable glow duration
- Custom spawner particles — choose from flame, soul fire, end rod, 
  enchant, smoke, portal, and many more, with a searchable in-game picker
- Ignore light level — let spawners work in any lighting conditions
- All settings editable in-game via Mod Menu, or manually in the config file

## Config

Open Mod Menu in-game, find Configurable Spawners, and click the 
settings button.

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) Required
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) Required

  
## **Compatibility**
- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Server-side — works in singleplayer too
